purpose: Tagger tags assigned to the cards/illustrations of fixtures/scryfall/mdfc.json, plus the full parent chain of each tag.
selector: oracle_tags: taggings[].oracle_id ∈ fixture oracle ids; art_tags: taggings[].illustration_id ∈ fixture illustration ids. Per target, tags sorted by (tagging has annotation / non-median weight first, tag has parents first, slug) and capped at 15 oracle / 10 art tags. Ancestors = transitive closure over parent_ids. taggings[] filtered to the fixture targets. Available per target: 562d71b9…: 11 oracle tags; 907ae517…: 24 oracle tags; 1c9bcbf6…: 10 art tags; 259cbafd…: 5 art tags; 25af817b…: 13 art tags; 9c4fd66b…: 8 art tags; b23da373…: 8 art tags; d13c8ed1…: 6 art tags.
note: Tag records are the original Tagger objects except: (1) taggings[] is FILTERED (see selector) and the fixture-added key `taggingsTotal` gives the unfiltered count; (2) child_ids[] is filtered to tags present in this file and the fixture-added key `childIdsTotal` gives the unfiltered count. parent_ids[] is complete: every ancestor is included, so the file is a closed sub-hierarchy in which child_ids is still the exact inverse of parent_ids. `taggingsTotal` and `childIdsTotal` are NOT source fields.

records.label: alliteration
records.description: Cards that alliterate, either properly or per Treacherous Trapezist.

records.label: mass reanimation
records.description: Reanimate everything (or every thing of a kind) from one or more graveyards (or potentially do this).

records.label: reanimate-creature
records.description: Return creature cards currently in the graveyard to the battlefield. Not to be confused with [cheat death](/tags/card/cheat-death), which interacts right as the creature dies.

records.label: virtual legendary
records.description: This card represents a one-of-a-kind creature or object (and is named accordingly), and could conceivably have been legendary. Usually cards are in this category because they were printed before legendary existed or have a mechanical need to not be legendary.

records.label: activated ability
records.description: Cards with activated abilities. Not for cards that only gain or give activated abilities.

records.label: cheaper than mv
records.description: The actual cost you pay for an effect (or for an alternate mode) will often be lower than the card's mana value.

records.label: multiple targets
records.description: These cards can target more than one object or player. Not mutually exclusive with [single target instant/sorcery](/tags/card/single-target-instant-sorcery).

records.label: single target instant/sorcery
records.description: Instant/sorcery spells that may target only one target. This is materially important for some effects that care about single targets. Not mutually exclusive with [multiple targets](/tags/card/multiple-targets).

records.label: banish-hand
records.description: Exile one or more cards from a player's hand as long as this remains in play.

records.label: mana producer
records.description: Nonland cards that generate mana.

records.label: mill-exile
records.description: Exile cards from the top of a library.

records.label: per-player
records.description: Effects that scale positively with the number of players; i. e., "for each player", "for each opponent", etc.

records.label: shapesharing
records.description: Something on the battlefield becomes a copy of something else.

records.label: spot removal
records.description: Removal for one target specifically.  See also [sweeper](sweeper) and [multi removal](multi-removal).

records.label: sweeper-graveyard
records.description: Remove all cards from one or more graveyards

records.label: kaldheim
records.description: IT'S COLD ❄️☃️ (as far as we can tell)

records.label: horn
records.description: Horns, as on the head. For the instrument see [horn (instrument)](horn-instrument). For horned helmets see [horned helmet](horned-helmet).

records.label: statue
records.description: A sculpted figure.

records.label: hedron
records.description: Geometric stone monoliths found throughout Zendikar

records.label: open pose
records.description: Arms outstretched either side of the body, typically conveying openness or confidence.

records.label: pauldron
records.description: A piece of armor that protects the shoulder and upper arm.

records.label: left-facing
records.description: Depicts a creature that is illustrated facing left (see Sly Spy)

records.label: solo
records.description: Only one figure is present in these artworks.

records.label: loose lips
records.description: Depicts a subject with an open mouth (see Knight of the Kitchen Sink)

records.label: armor
records.description: Garments designed to protect one from physical harm.

records.label: art media
records.description: Media used to render the artwork.

records.label: character
records.description: Named characters.

records.label: clothing
records.description: Tags describing varieties of clothing.

records.label: eye
records.description: Tags describing eyes. See also [eyes covered](/tags/artwork/eyes-covered) and [eyepatch](/tags/artwork/eyepatch). For the creature, see [eye (creature)](/tags/artwork/eye-creature).

records.label: eye colors
records.description: Tags describing eye colors, including all-white or all-black eyes.

records.label: god
records.description: The gods of various planes.

records.label: hand
records.description: Depicts a hand entering from out of frame.

records.label: humanoid
records.description: Beings shaped like humans. For critters that look similar to humans but aren't necessarily shaped like one, see [anthropomorphic](anthropomorphic).

records.label: ondu
records.description: A continent of Zendikar

records.label: planar origin
records.description: Tags classifying the origins of creatures and objects from across the multiverse.

records.label: plane
records.description: A collection of art tags that relate to specific planes.

records.label: planeswalker
records.description: A character who is, or was, a planeswalker.

records.label: pose
records.description: Tags describing someone's pose.

records.label: sculpture
records.description: A sculpted work, from carved stone, cast metal, etc.

records.label: shoulder pad
records.description: Prominent, shaped shoulder clothing, either part of another garment or a standalone piece. See [pauldron](pauldron) for shoulder armor.

records.label: skoti
records.description: The current ruling family of gods on Kaldheim.

records.label: banish
records.description: Exile things as long as this permanent remains.

records.label: boltland
records.description: Lands you can pay 3 life/take 3 damage to have them enter untapped.

records.label: card advantage
records.description: Things that give you access to more cards.  (The technical meaning of card advantage can be much broader than this, but this is what we're using here.)

records.label: card names
records.description: A collection of tags identifying properties and naming schemes in cards.

records.label: conditional tapland
records.description: Lands that will enter the battlefield tapped or untapped depending on certain conditions.

records.label: control changing effects
records.description: Effects that change control of cards, permanents, and spells.

records.label: copy
records.description: Effects that copy things

records.label: cycle
records.description: All the cycles from Magic history.

records.label: cycle-land
records.description: All the land cycles. See in particular: [monocolor land cycles](/tags/card/cycle-mono-land), [dual land cycles](/tags/card/cycle-dual-land), and [triland cycles](/tags/card/cycle-triland).

records.label: cycle-mono-land
records.description: Monocolor land cycles.

records.label: discard to exile
records.description: Put cards from the opponent's hand into exile, either permanently or by [banishing](banish-hand) them.

records.label: gives castable from exile
records.description: Cards that let you cast things from exile.

records.label: gives castable from nonhand
records.description: Allows you to play other cards from zones other than your hand.

records.label: hand disruption
records.description: Mess with your opponent's hand.

records.label: hate
records.description: Cards that hate on things — colors, card types, zones, etc.

records.label: impulsive draw
records.description: Cards which let you cast a card for a limited time off the top of a library (via exile). Use it or lose it. Typically a red card advantage mechanic. See also [impulsive mill](impulsive-mill). For the effect seen on the [card Impulse](/card/vis/34), see the [tag impulse](impulse).

records.label: life payment
records.description: Cards that cost life to use; not necessarily with the "pay" keyword.

records.label: mill
records.description: A keyword action used in Magic to describe the action of a player taking cards from the top of their library and putting them into their graveyard.

records.label: multiplayer
records.description: Cards that interact with all of the players in the game. They might scale with the number of players or affect the turn order for example.

records.label: ramp
records.description: Effects that increase available mana for current or later turns.

records.label: reanimate
records.description: Return permanent cards from the graveyard to the battlefield.

records.label: recursion
records.description: Get stuff back from your graveyard to use it again. See: reanimate (to battlefield), regrowth (to hand), and restock (to library).

records.label: red effect
records.description: Effects which are iconically red.

records.label: removal
records.description: Get things off the table.

records.label: repeatable card advantage
records.description: Things that give you access to more cards, repeatably.

records.label: theft
records.description: Effects that let you steal cards and resources from your opponent.
